knownBoundaries: Only local Codex; Claude and remote explicitly reject image input
Accepted uploads survive draft removal so sent/history references remain valid; no automatic image garbage collection in this milestone
A draft copied to a fork preserves original images for recovery but asks to attach them in the new Agent before sending
Once image receipts exist, old Core releases cannot read them. Existing actual-records verifier refuses rollback, verified read-only against the isolated test DB
Browser upload-in-progress warns before reload and blocks managed update reload; completed uploads and failed sends retain durable draft references
manualAcceptance: Open a local Codex Agent, paste a screenshot or choose PNG/JPEG/WebP with Add images
Hover a thumbnail, click it for original preview, press Escape to close, remove an image
Switch Agents or refresh: saved images and text remain
Send one or several images with text, or send images alone; click their thumbnails in the original user message after refreshing
On a slow send type more text: the successful old send must not clear the new draft
Fork a local Codex conversation containing a sent image: the inherited thumbnail and full image still open from the source owner; the source Agent and stored image must still exist
Claude or remote Agents show the unsupported explanation; use local Codex for this milestone
